note: signup: the free-guide sign-up and the coaching waiting list both post to one Google Form (no backend needed). form_id is the long id in the form's pre-filled link (docs.google.com/forms/d/e/<form_id>/viewform); entries are the entry.N numbers for the Email, Name, Goal, Language and Source questions. Empty form_id = the form copies the details and opens an Instagram message instead. guide.pdf = file name inside site/guide/ (empty = 'we will send it' message).
